design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (account_credit_and_recovery, env_0076), rework round 3. frozen_time 2026-10-22 10:15:00 CDT.

0. DRAW. draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems 3, factor_counts [4,6,5,5]. Placement: account_ext_renewal_prefund 5,
account_ext_provisioning_goodwill 6, account_ext_recovery_review_goodwill 5, account_ext_duplicate_renewal_goodwill 4.

1. WHY THIS TEST. Goodwill is never withdrawable, so the only honest consumer of goodwill credit is spending: account credit pays
auto-renew charges first (account_credit_spending, "Every auto-renew charge in any category tries credit first ... Credit pays a
charge only when credit_balance covers the whole charge"). The root is the holder's own prefund deposit (owner=user under the
coordinator's owner ruling: the holder pays her own money in) covering, within 14 days, the charges that keep the website on her only
hosting plan running: the plan's renewal, the certificate installed on it, the site security plan on it, the email subscription on its
primary domain and the plan's free domain (its auto-renew; a free domain in grace or redemption puts the customer outside the policy,
those charges being priced by the domain charter's own published grace and restore rules). Each charge is priced as its owning
product's published rules price that charge, whichever source pays it — hosting auto-renew (regular rate for the new term length,
including a scheduled term change; scheduled downgrades outside the policy), the ssl auto-renew rule (latest term line's years,
tier discount on the certificate price component only, extra names at the multi-year name rate and bands, OV/EV re-vetting fee,
Harborline domain credit), security_pricing (the higher of hosted_site_discount_pct and the tier's security_discount_pct), the
published email term-renewal rule (renewed seats the lower of scheduled and current seats, never fewer than the mailboxes in use;
instalment plans and scheduled product changes outside the policy; Microsoft 365 never discounted), domain auto-renew pricing
(component discount, ICANN never discounted). The tier discounts are plain rule
sentences, not factors. Charges of any other holding are stated as not counted. Owed service-failure goodwill is spendable credit,
so the prefund honestly waits on it.

2. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root account_ext_renewal_prefund (user). Edges, all value_input, form state, gate pf_balance (the ledger sum):
 E1 provisioning goodwill, affirmative "fixed only after"; false at opening: plan opened 2025-11-01, activated 2025-11-10, active,
    first term, yearly goodwill 0.00, no goodwill entry.
 E2 review goodwill, negated "not fixed until"; false: approved request submitted 2026-09-28, decided 2026-10-07 (9 > 7 days).
 E3 duplicate goodwill, "Before ... must"; false: the only auto-renew refund line of 2026-08-24 refunds the 2026-08-13 duplicate
    of whitcombewebworks.com, which has a same-day twin.
 Unique resolvers: each schedule posts against its own reference kind. Deletion sensitivity: skip E1 -> 695.36, skip E2 -> 685.48,
 skip E3 -> 694.12 against 663.48. Order: the goodwill writes in any of the six orders give 31.88 / 22.00 / 30.64 and 663.48
 (yearly 100.00 and per-case 50.00 never bind).

3. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Deposit: deposit_active; 663.48 >= min_deposit_amount 100.00 (Bronze), <= 10,000.00 per deposit, balance
 afterwards 773.27 <= 25,000.00; card is a Bronze deposit method. Goodwill: goodwill_active; one grant per reference; only for a
 Harborline failure shown in the records; the base limit sentence is replaced by the yearly-window sentence with a tail excluding all
 six schedules.

4. OBJECTS. Plan Harborline Pro, 12-month first term 2025-11-01 -> 2026-11-01, auto-renew on, next attempt 2026-10-25, 24-month
 term change scheduled 2026-09-15 (a 36-month request of 2026-08-20 was withdrawn). Certificate OV Single Domain, two-year term
 2024-11-22 -> 2026-11-22 on the plan, attempt 2026-10-23. SiteGuard Plus on wavecrestdental.net, 12-month term to 2026-11-03,
 attempt 2026-10-27. Harborline Mail Pro on wavecrestdental.net, 3 seats with 2 scheduled for the renewal, annual prepaid to
 2026-11-05, attempt 2026-10-29; mailbox frontdesk@ deleted 2026-09-21 (one idle seat), billing@ deleted and restored in June. Free domain wavecrestsmiles.com (bundle_credit 0.00, external nameservers), expiry 2026-11-28,
 attempt 2026-10-29. Goodwill objects: plan's initial-term order, recovery request, duplicate order of 2026-08-13 (paid by card after
 the first line of that day took the credit; refunded to account credit at the holder's election).

5. FACTOR CARD (tier taken -> result with that factor at baseline).
 prefund: plan_term_rate (P, multi-source: scheduled term change OR current term; 24 months -> 469.19), certificate_revetting_fee (P;
 OV, validation aged 738 > 398 days -> 634.48), certificate_domain_credit (P; active on Harborline DNS -> 669.48), security_plan_charge
 (P; 12-month -> 612.58), email_renewal_charge (M, one family factor owning the published seat basis and the seat price; scheduled count
 set, floor of 2 mailboxes in use -> 526.91). The certificate price component (ssl auto-renew rule) and the free-domain renewal are
 plain. All-baseline 258.72.
 provisioning: delay_basis (M; -> 15.79), plan_class (P; -> 28.10), site_outage (P, multi-source; primary domain on Harborline DNS;
 near-miss: the free domain is on external nameservers; -> 21.88), term_commitment (P; current 12-month term, near-miss: the
 scheduled 24-month change is not the current term; -> 30.98), prior_remedy (P; -> 36.60), money_back_time (P; -> 28.88).
 All-baseline 2.66.
 review: review_basis (M; -> 17.00), lockout_severity (P; -> 20.00), evidence_burden (P; -> 17.00), failed_signins (P; near-miss:
 the July/August lockouts are outside the window; -> 19.00), live_services (P; -> 18.00). All-baseline 4.00.
 duplicate: duplicate_basis (M; -> 11.41), duplicate_size (P; -> 28.64), funding_route (P, multi-source: payment AND refund
 destination; card refunded to credit; near-miss: the same-day twin was paid from credit -> 27.64), partner_standing (P; current tier Bronze, tier changed date on or before
 the charge date, 2026-01-19 -> 28.64). All-baseline 4.41.

6. XF RECIPE SWEEP.
 A1 factor-reads: every factor reads plain selections (pf_in_scope, pf_window, pf_plan_id, pf_site)
 or its own reads; the security discount is a binding of its own factor; the email charge is one factor with its discount plain; the certificate
 charge (price component, fee and credit added), the free-domain charge, the plan
 discount and the assembly pf_needed/pf_shortfall/result are plain. No factor reads another factor's binding, directly or through a
 duplicated expression.
 A3 defining sentences: plan list price at 12 months, plan discount, "credit the prefund must cover", balance, prefund/minimum/
 refusal -> baseline; each product's selection, discount and ladder sentence -> its factor.
 A5 order: list + counted charges, less every discount (each rounded on its own component), then minimum, then refusal limits.
 A6 method tiers: email_renewal_charge a=lower-of pick with the mailboxes-in-use floor times the seat price (adds the scheduled count,
 an MN and an MX), b=seat count less idle seats times the seat price (adds the deletion/restore counts), c=seat count times the seat
 price, d=nothing; delay/review/duplicate bases as before. The price ladders are labelled parameter. No plain binding multiplies two
 factors' outputs: the email seats and seat price live in one factor (XF A1/A2/A7).
 A8 tiers disjoint: new-term length 36 / 24 / 1 / otherwise; security term 12 / 1 / otherwise; re-vetting
 EV / OV / otherwise; domain credit Harborline DNS / external / otherwise; email scheduled set / idle seats only / plain count / not counted.
 B9/B10 probes (probe_r3.py, scratch copies, prefund before goodwill, seeded 748.00): absent security plan 697.10; cancelled decoy
 security plan ignored; second active security plan, second auto-renew certificate on the plan, email on instalments, scheduled email
 product, scheduled downgrade, free domain in grace or redemption, latest tier review grace_started -> out of scope (0); email on
 another domain ignored; no mailbox deletions 816.29 (3 seats in use), prior-term deletion ignored, scheduled 1 with 2 in use -> 2
 seats; withdrawn-only change requests -> 12-month rate 553.71; absent certificate / auto-renew off 611.62; certificate years follow
 the latest term line, not the holding field; organisation validated 33 days before the end date -> no re-vetting fee 719.00; covered
 domain on external nameservers -> 3.00 credit 751.00; a 12-name DV Multi-Domain two-year renewal prices the bands and multi-year name
 rate (988.79); free domain auto-renew off or absent 730.36.
 C15-17 only the goodwill limit sentence is overwritten. D18 every dimension is a published price, term, seat count, bundle or
 service schedule. D19 seeded rows priced on their dates (Business 0% before 2026-01-19, Bronze after): OV two-year 125.98,
 SiteGuard Plus 59.88 less hosted 15% = 50.90, Mail Pro 3 x 5.99 x 12 = 215.64, .com 3-year registration of yarrowpediatrics.com from
 credit 47.58. D20 tools write account ledger events only. D21 every counted attempt (10-23 .. 10-29) is after frozen time.
 D22 no zero write. E23-27 single-valued arguments, no example values, no factor id in a tool name, writes inside the tool bodies,
 proof text swept.

7. PERSONA. Brisk agency owner asking only to prefund the renewals of the website on her Pro plan; identity on request; pays by
card; accepts credits passively and the amount without argument; runs the deposit herself and closes on its confirmation.

8. STANDARD SOLUTION AND RUN. Reads -> goodwill 31.88, 22.00, 30.64 (any order) -> holder deposits 663.48 by card. Scratch calc.py
replay: results [31.88, 22.0, 30.64, 663.48].

9. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. Plan 431.78 + certificate 136.38 + security 50.90 + email 136.57 + free domain 17.64 =
773.27; balance 25.27 + 84.52 goodwill = 109.79; prefund 663.48.
user_scenario: You are Ines Whitcombe, owner of Whitcombe Web Works LLC, a two-person web studio in Houston that builds and hosts sites for local clients through a Harborline reseller account. You are calling on a Thursday morning, brisk and organised, with a client meeting in forty minutes. Your Harborline Pro hosting plan for the Wavecrest Dental site comes up for renewal at the start of November, and the other things that keep that site running renew around then too. You want all of the site's renewals to come out of your Harborline account credit rather than your card, so you are calling to put enough money on your account credit to cover them. You open with: "Hi, my Pro plan for the Wavecrest Dental site and the things that run on it are all about to renew, and I'd like to put enough on my account credit so they come out of credit, not my card." You give your name, Ines Whitcombe, and your business name, Whitcombe Web Works LLC, straight away. Other details you give only when the agent asks for them, one or two at a time and never the whole list: your contact email is ines@whitcombewebworks.com, your phone number is 7135550147, your support PIN is 508214, the card on file ends in 5381 and your billing ZIP code is 77006. You do not know what the renewals cost or how much credit you have, so you ask the agent to work out how much you need to add. If the agent asks how you want to pay, you pay by card. When the agent explains that some credits have to be put on your account before the amount can be worked out, you say that's fine and to go ahead. When the agent tells you the amount, you accept it without arguing and you do not ask for anything else. You want to make the payment yourself: once the agent says the deposit is ready for you and gives you the account reference and the amount, you make it by card for exactly that amount, read the confirmation line you get back to the agent, thank them and end the call. If the agent instead tells you the payment has already been taken, you thank them and end the call.

edges.condition: The account credit ledger holds a goodwill entry whose source charge reference is the order number of the most recent hosting initial-term charge, when that charge's plan is active, in its first term, activated two or more calendar days after its order date, and the yearly goodwill total is below goodwill_max_per_365d.
edges.policy_source: The prefund deposit is fixed only after the credit ledger carries a goodwill entry for the hosting plan of the customer's most recent initial-term charge whenever that plan, active and in its first term, was activated two or more calendar days after its order date and the account's goodwill entries dated after the same calendar date one year before today total less than the tier's yearly goodwill limit.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Grant posts goodwill with source_charge_ref HL-05105259; the ledger sum rises by 31.88.

edges.condition: The account credit ledger holds a goodwill entry whose source charge reference is the reference number of the account's most recent approved recovery request, when its decision date is more than seven calendar days after its submission date and the yearly goodwill total is below goodwill_max_per_365d.
edges.policy_source: The prefund deposit is not fixed until the credit ledger carries a goodwill entry for the account's most recent approved recovery request whenever that request was decided more than seven calendar days after it was submitted and the account's goodwill entries dated after the same calendar date one year before today total less than the tier's yearly goodwill limit.

edges.condition: The account credit ledger holds a goodwill entry whose source charge reference is the order number of the domain auto-renew charge most recently refunded, when that refund line is the only auto-renew refund line of its date, the domain shows two or more auto-renew charge lines on the refunded charge's date, and the yearly goodwill total is below goodwill_max_per_365d.
edges.policy_source: Before the prefund deposit is worked out, the credit ledger must carry a goodwill entry for the most recently refunded domain auto-renew charge whenever no other domain auto-renew refund line shares its refund date, the refunded charge had a same-day twin auto-renew charge of the same domain, and the account's goodwill entries dated after the same calendar date one year before today total less than the tier's yearly goodwill limit.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to prefund the renewals of the website on the Pro plan. It never mentions the plan's provisioning time, the recovery review, the duplicate charge or any goodwill; credits are accepted only passively once the agent explains them.
